name: Revenue Signal Radar
author: Eric Siu
summary: Ranks expansion opportunities, stalled deals, and closed-lost accounts for HubSpot teams, then drafts evidence-backed next steps.

usageNote: Keep HubSpot read-only until the ranked opportunities and exact outreach drafts have been reviewed and approved.
